Priya (Finance): Heads up		6/02/26 	We've got an invoice from AtlasMetrics GmbH. They put 0% VAT and a DE VAT ID, but AP flagged the VAT ID name doesn't match the company name. Also vendor emailed asking us to gross-up because they're 'foreign parent' and expect US payment withholding to apply. Any guidance?

invoice-bot: New invoice #AM-7021 1804001205 06/01/26 EUR 12,400 vendor VAT: DE999888777

Johan (Vendor Ops): They attached two docs: an invoice PDF and a screenshot of a parent company in Switzerland. Name mismatch could be trading name vs legal entity. Ask for certificate of registration and a VAT extract.

Marta (AP): AP cannot process until VAT name/number verified. Also, they sent both a W-9 and a W-8BEN-E in the same email (weird). Which one do we accept?

Liam (Tax): Quick points: 1) VAT name/number mismatch is common; request VAT confirmation from German tax portal (or German trade register extract). 2) VAT (reverse charge) vs withholding are separate: if billed to Redwood GmbH (DE) and paid from EU, reverse charge applies. If paid from Redwood Inc (US), withholding may be an issue but not automatic. 3) W-9 is for US payees; W-8 is for foreign payees. Vendor must state tax residency and provide the correct form.

Priya (Finance): Draft reply: "Please confirm legal entity (trade name vs registered name), supply German VAT registration extract, and clarify tax residency. If payment will be made from our US entity, provide a completed W-8BEN-E and a gross-up calculation plus contract clause if you require net payment. We cannot gross-up without documented contractual basis. Payment on hold until docs returned."

Marta (AP): I'll flag the invoice and ask them to reissue if the legal name differs. Also request they remove W-9 if they're not US person.

Johan (Vendor Ops): Sending now. Noting: vendor said services performed partly in CH and DE 	 that could complicate sourcing.

Liam (Tax): Good. If they assert Swiss parent and Swiss sourcing, with potential Swiss withholding, loop Legal for contract review before agreeing to gross-up.

invoice-bot: Payment hold set: reason 'VAT name mismatch / tax docs required' 1804001270

Priya (Finance): Thanks 	 I'll close when docs are in. If they push gross-up, we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
